purpose: Teach: 建材/渡米/前月/スペシャリスト/リコール/各所/積む/段ボール

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 建材の調達、本気で、絶対、コスト、絶対、見直しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: I need the building materials procurement cost review done. Don't cut corners on this—I'm serious.
lines.style: Clipped, direct authority. Sharp attack on the opening. No softening. Each clause lands like an order. Final thought carries weight and finality.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。海外駐在員の渡米、本気で、絶対、手配、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. We're handling the expat's US assignment right now. Thank you for the opportunity to take this on.
lines.style: Steady, reassuring competence. Even rhythm. Professional formality without stiffness. A promise wrapped in courtesy. Slight lift at the end—showing readiness.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 前月の業績、本気で、絶対、報告、絶対、まとめろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: I need last month's performance report compiled and ready. Make sure it's thorough.
lines.style: Direct instruction. Measured pace. Clipped phrasing. The tone of someone used to being obeyed. Not harsh—just exact.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。業界スペシャリスト、本気で、絶対、当社に、絶対、お招きしております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. We've already reached out to bring in an industry specialist. Thank you for authorizing this.
lines.style: Calm update. Even tone, professional rhythm. The satisfaction of showing progress without needing praise. Respectful without servility.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 製品の不具合、本気で、絶対、リコール、絶対、対応、絶対、徹底させろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: The product defect recall needs an immediate, thorough response. Make absolutely sure it's handled everywhere it needs to be.
lines.style: Urgent but controlled. Sharp opening. Emphasis on 'thorough'—the word carries extra weight. No room for partial measures. Closing emphasis shows this matters.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。各所への、本気で、絶対、ご連絡、絶対、徹底しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. All relevant departments have been notified. We're ensuring complete coordination on this.
lines.style: Calm assurance. Professional rhythm without rush. Subtext: this is already in motion and well-managed. Slight dignity in the delivery.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 倉庫の在庫、本気で、絶対、適切に、絶対、積むよう、絶対、徹底しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Warehouse inventory needs to be stacked properly and systematically. I want complete consistency on this.
lines.style: Methodical authority. Measured pace. Each phrase reinforces the standard. No urgency, but absolute clarity of expectation. The tone of someone checking foundations.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。出荷の段ボール、本気で、絶対、品質、絶対、確認、絶対、徹底しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. Every shipment's packaging is being inspected for quality. We're keeping standards high on this.
lines.style: Assured closure. Steady rhythm. The satisfaction of a process running correctly. Professional, grounded. Ends with quiet confidence in the work.
